Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤔. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 🤕.

JACK:
(suddenly alert)
No! I won't take it! It's poison! 🚽

DR. SMITH:
(calmly)
Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need to take your medication to manage your symptoms 💊.

JACK:
(defiantly)
I won't do it! You can't make me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(firmly)
Jack, I'm your doctor. I know what's best for you. Now, take the pills or I'll have to restrain you 🚔.

Jack looks up at Dr. Smith, a mischievous glint in his eye 😈. Dr. Smith hesitates for a moment, then reluctantly takes the glass from Jack's hand and forces him to swallow the pills 💉.

As Dr. Smith opens his eyes, he's met with an unsettling sight: Jack is gone 🤯. The hospital bed is empty, except for a small note on the bedside table that reads: "I'm not real" 📝.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been living in a world of his own creation, and Jack was just a figment of his imagination 🌐. The medication, the hospital, everything - it's all been a product of his own paranoid delusions 🤪.

Dr. Smith's face contorts in a mixture of fear and despair as he stumbles backward, tripping over his own feet 🤦‍♂️. He falls to the ground, his eyes fixed on the empty bed, as the sound of his own maniacal laughter echoes through the asylum 🎃.

FADE TO BLACK 🌑
